Music while you browse; it fades out and stops while a game runs, and stays quiet when another app plays. My music plays your own songs from ROMs/tandem/music (MP3, OGG, Opus, FLAC, M4A, WAV); it\'s empty right now, so the built-in soundtrack plays (%1$s). Tandem\'s own: Plaza, bright and bouncy marimba, whistle and bossa; Calm, slow and soft piano, harp and celesta; or Meadow Tales, a small orchestra.

resources.string: Play the music folder in a random order.
Your handheld\'s bottom-screen volume is at zero, and it mutes Tandem too: raise it in Dual screen assistant (Bottom screen › Volume).
Soft taps and gentle tones, short and quiet, like a current console. Tandem\'s own sound.
Glassy marimba taps and warm chimes: Tandem\'s original, cheerful set.
Square-wave blips and coin-box fanfares, like an 8-bit console.
Round water-drop bloops and fizzy sparkles.
Quiet, short and subtle. Barely there.
Felt and wood: low, warm taps with a soft thump, like a well-made keyboard.
Deep, muted thocks, like a mechanical keyboard with good switches.
Clean, bright crystal tones that ring a little longer. Crisp and polished.
Soft breaths and pure, rounded tones. Calm and spacious.
Soft piano on a quiet lake at dusk
Harp and celesta as the light comes in
Flute and piano on a sunny, windy hill
An accordion waltz in a lamplit little town
A little train along the coast, waves out of the window
Little spirits dancing between the old trees
Piano and soft rain on a lazy summer afternoon
Soaring over the fields on the way home
A whistled tune and marimba in a sunny little square
Nylon guitar and a bossa beat, browsing the shelves
A music-box waltz for the quiet hours
A bright little fanfare for good news
